identity.title: Weather Qualification Corpus Completion
identity.objective: Complete the frozen S10-QUAL-DATA-01 weather qualification corpus in one bounded run: verify the exact PR #202 run-01 seed with the predecessor code, admit only its hash-valid successful raw artifacts as a cache, re-derive the whole corpus with the unchanged DATA-01 semantics plus the D011 failed-read rules (BBA source-invalid, LTP not searched, LABEL_V3_SOURCE_READ_FAILED, explicit tick failures), a frozen 429/503 backoff and bounded new-network caps, and seal a verified content-addressed bundle with terminal QUAL_DATA_READY or QUAL_DATA_INSUFFICIENT. Data formation only: no QualificationCandidate, gate run, predictive metric, dependency/workflow change, credential, paper, execution or live authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-QUAL-DATA-02. The completion operator, its tests, the contract/status/spec docs and the additive LABEL_V3_SOURCE_READ_FAILED code disappear; the S10-QUAL-DATA-01 derivation code returns to its PR #202 bytes. Ignored local_data evidence (DATA-01 seed and DATA-02 workspace) is untouched by revert; dependencies, workflows, qualification contracts and all runtime, order and capital state are unchanged.

api_matrix.reason: No product or trading API is added; the operator consumes the existing verified PolymarketPublicClient.get_market unchanged and public read-only research endpoints only.

semantic_fields.reason: These rules freeze seed discovery/verification/admission, D011 read-state rules, retry policy, network allowlist and caps, the unchanged DATA-01 corpus semantics, probe gate, finalization, authority and successor boundary.

items.required_rule: prepare discovers local_data/s10_qual_data_01/run-01 only under git worktree roots; byte-identical valid copies agree; disagreeing valid stores -> SEED_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT; none valid -> SEED_EVIDENCE_MISSING with no fallback fresh run.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: The seed plan code digests equal the exact 33c031f41626550294eb6667620b4ce75589d719 blobs; terminal QUAL_DATA_INSUFFICIENT / FROZEN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED; bundle weatherqualbundle:sha256:ceca0252b4d41cf9b49591bb3a65ed9e0b79d9321b269ecbab86f5a90ea085e1 and dataset weatherqualdataset:sha256:9058a05354390ca7e61bcb47871f93b925e99571f7cc48f40b057eb0e8454413; verify-final VERIFIED; every admitted artifact hash-valid.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Only successful immutable raw artifacts plus truthful source metadata are seeded; failed entries are never admitted (0); rows, exclusions, bundle, manifests, scanned-hour, label and execution decisions are never seeded; seed path/user/host never enter identity.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: The whole corpus is re-derived; the seed is a content-addressed cache whose use cannot change the sealed bundle.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: A failed required best_bid_ask hour is not scanned; a pair walking through it is MARKET_HISTORY_SOURCE_INVALID and its deeper walk-back stops.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: A failed last_trade_price hour is not listed as searched, is recorded as failed and never implies absence.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: A failed required market_resolved read -> LABEL_V3_SOURCE_READ_FAILED; LABEL_V3_RESOLUTION_MISSING only after a successful relevant-window read without a qualifying resolution.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: A failed tick_size_change hour stays explicit and not successfully searched; CURRENT_ONLY remains only on independent current Gamma metadata.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Exactly LABEL_V3_SOURCE_READ_FAILED is added, only in qualification_data_readiness.py, as a market-level exclusion.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: HTTP 429/503: initial + max 3 retries after 2s, 8s, 30s; an integer Retry-After in [0,60] gives max(frozen delay, Retry-After); otherwise frozen; no jitter, random or adaptive retry.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Timeout/reset/RemoteDisconnected/truncation and other retryable statuses keep one immediate retry; an exhausted retry is a closed source failure, never source absence.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Only tools/qualification/run_s10_qual_data_02.py performs source traffic: https GET/HEAD/Range to archive.pendulumflow.com, noaa-ndfd-pds.s3.amazonaws.com, gamma-api.polymarket.com (public client only), api.weather.gov; no redirect, auth or arbitrary URL.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: New-network caps 12,288 attempts, 6,442,450,944 bytes, 268,435,456 per response, 2,000 distinct PendulumFlow hours; probe counts, seed bytes do not; never raised during the run; exhaustion -> QUAL_DATA_INSUFFICIENT / FROZEN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Dates 2026-08-18..2026-09-26, checkpoints MARKET_OBSERVABLE_PLUS_60M_V1 and TARGET_CLIMATE_DAY_START_V1, 24h market history, 48h NDFD, 30-minute label window, whole-object NDFD PoP12, THIRD_PARTY_NATIVE_FRAME_ARCHIVE, three finality policies and external-only B0 are unchanged.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: probe-sources proves a seed cache hit, one live unseeded fetch equal to its seed bytes, a typed D011 failure, Gamma identity and production NDFD decode; PROBE_PASS is required before run-completion.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: run-completion runs once; a finalized workspace refuses another run; verify-final is zero network and replays identities, counts, seed and network accounting.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: No QualificationCandidate, qualification gate, WP170/WP172/WP173, credential, scheduler, Hermes, strategy, paper, execution, live, Gate C, capital or order path.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: QUAL_DATA_READY returns to Side14 (next: the smallest B0 provenance / qualification-contract compatibility package, not automatic); QUAL_DATA_INSUFFICIENT returns evidence with no automatic rerun, budget increase, expansion or tuning.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure
